estimates.name: Consolidated Results of Operations
estimates.t: The following table sets forth our results of operations for the periods presented, in dollars:

estimates.name: Comparison of Three Months Ended September 30, 2026 and 2025 — Revenue
estimates.t: Revenue increased $18.2 million, or 33.9%, to $72.0 million for the three months ended September 30, 2026 as compared to $53.8 million for the three months ended September 30, 2025.

estimates.name: Cost of Revenue and Gross Margin
estimates.t: Cost of revenue increased $6.2 million, or 38.5%, for the three months ended September 30, 2026 compared to the three months ended September 30, 2025.

estimates.name: Operating Expenses — Sales, General and Administrative Expense
estimates.t: Sales, general and administrative, or SG&A, expense increased $10.9 million, or 29.2%, to $48.0 million for the three months ended September 30, 2026, compared to $37.2 million for the three months ended September 30, 2025.
estimates.effect: Sales, general and administrative, or SG&A, expense increased $10.9 million, or 29.2%, to $48.0 million for the three months ended September 30, 2026, compared to $37.2 million for the three months ended September 30, 2025.

estimates.name: Research and Development Expense
estimates.t: Research and development, or R&D, expense was relatively consistent at $4.3 million for the three months ended September 30, 2026, compared to $4.6 million for the three months ended September 30, 2025.
estimates.effect: Research and development, or R&D, expense was relatively consistent at $4.3 million for the three months ended September 30, 2026, compared to $4.6 million for the three months ended September 30, 2025.

estimates.name: Interest Expense
estimates.t: Interest expense for the three months ended September 30, 2026 was $6.8 million as compared to $6.2 million for the three months ended September 30, 2025.
estimates.effect: Interest expense for the three months ended September 30, 2026 was $6.8 million as compared to $6.2 million for the three months ended September 30, 2025.

estimates.name: Provision for Income Taxes
estimates.t: Provision for income taxes increased $0.2 million, or 44.3%, to $612 thousand for the three months ended September 30, 2026, compared to $0.4 million for the three months ended September 30, 2025.
estimates.effect: Provision for income taxes increased $0.2 million, or 44.3%, to $612 thousand for the three months ended September 30, 2026, compared to $0.4 million for the three months ended September 30, 2025.

estimates.name: Other (Income) Expense, Net
estimates.t: Other (income) expense, net, changed $0.2 million to a loss of $0.7 million for the three months ended September 30, 2026, compared to a loss of $0.5 million for the three months ended September 30, 2025.
estimates.effect: Other (income) expense, net, changed $0.2 million to a loss of $0.7 million for the three months ended September 30, 2026, compared to a loss of $0.5 million for the three months ended September 30, 2025.

estimates.name: Comparison of Nine Months Ended September 30, 2026 and 2025 — Revenue
estimates.t: Revenue increased $53.0 million, or 36.2%, to $199.4 million for the nine months ended September 30, 2026 as compared to $146.5 million for the nine months ended September 30, 2025.

estimates.name: Cost of Revenue and Gross Margin
estimates.t: Cost of revenue increased $14.0 million, or 30.6%, to $59.7 million for the nine months ended September 30, 2026 compared to $45.7 million for the nine months ended September 30, 2025.

estimates.name: Operating Expenses — Sales, General and Administrative Expense
estimates.t: SG&A expense increased $17.5 million, or 14.5%, to $138.5 million for the nine months ended September 30, 2026, compared to $121.0 million for the nine months ended September 30, 2025.
estimates.effect: SG&A expense increased $17.5 million, or 14.5%, to $138.5 million for the nine months ended September 30, 2026, compared to $121.0 million for the nine months ended September 30, 2025.

estimates.name: Research and Development Expense
estimates.t: R&D expense remained consistent at $14.7 million for the nine months ended September 30, 2026, compared to $14.8 million for the nine months ended September 30, 2025.
estimates.effect: R&D expense remained consistent at $14.7 million for the nine months ended September 30, 2026, compared to $14.8 million for the nine months ended September 30, 2025.

estimates.name: Interest Expense
estimates.t: Interest expense was $20.9 million for the nine months ended September 30, 2026, compared to $18.0 million for the nine months ended September 30, 2025.
estimates.effect: Interest expense was $20.9 million for the nine months ended September 30, 2026, compared to $18.0 million for the nine months ended September 30, 2025.

estimates.name: Provision for Income Taxes
estimates.t: Provision for income taxes decreased $1.4 million, or 61.3%, to $0.9 million for the nine months ended September 30, 2026, compared to $2.3 million for the nine months ended September 30, 2025.
estimates.effect: Provision for income taxes decreased $1.4 million, or 61.3%, to $0.9 million for the nine months ended September 30, 2026, compared to $2.3 million for the nine months ended September 30, 2025.

estimates.name: Other (Income) Expense, Net
estimates.t: Other (income) expense, net decreased $7.6 million to a loss of $0.6 million for the nine months ended September 30, 2026, compared to an income of $7.0 million for the nine months ended September 30, 2025.
estimates.effect: Other (income) expense, net decreased $7.6 million to a loss of $0.6 million for the nine months ended September 30, 2026, compared to an income of $7.0 million for the nine months ended September 30, 2025.
